function.name: law_case_search_find_historical
function.description: Search for a historical law case based on specific criteria like the subject and year.

subject.description: The subject matter of the case, e.g., 'fraud'

from_year.description: The start year for the range of the case. The case should happen after this year.

to_year.description: The end year for the range of the case. The case should happen before this year.
